offers.sn: About Ubiquiti At Ubiquiti Inc., we create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere.
offers.rq: BS degree or above in electrical engineering or related field; 5+ years of hands-on experience in consumer electronics/embedded systems design, prototype, bring up, debugging, functional verification and NPI support, DFx (Design for cost, test, manufacturing) experience; Proficient English and Latvian.
